target.body:
﻿## What Problem This Solves

ClawSweeper now treats Mantis web UI chat proof as a supported proof lane in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/424, but OpenClaw did not yet have a focused Mantis workflow that can run and publish that proof. This PR adds the OpenClaw side so `@openclaw-mantis web ui chat` has a real, bounded implementation instead of being only policy text.

## Why This Change Was Made

The intended scope is deliberately narrow: OpenClaw web UI chat transcript and chat interaction proof only. This does not make Mantis a general browser, WinUI, dashboard, settings-page, or arbitrary visual proof worker. Those surfaces should still use ordinary Playwright/browser proof, maintainer screenshots/manual proof, Crabbox where appropriate, or normal local artifacts.

## User Impact

Maintainers get a dedicated web UI chat proof lane that can validate a candidate ref, run a focused Control UI chat E2E proof, produce screenshot/video/metadata artifacts, and publish Mantis evidence for PR review. Contributors do not get a new product-facing UI feature.

## Implementation

- Adds `Mantis Web UI Chat Proof`, triggered by maintainer-authored PR comments or manual workflow dispatch.
- Validates candidate refs so the workflow only runs against main ancestry, release tags, or same-repo PR heads.
- Runs dependencies, Playwright browser install, and Vitest from the candidate checkout, while copying the trusted proof harness into the candidate worktree for stale candidates.
- Adds a focused Control UI chat proof that mocks Gateway traffic, sends a chat prompt, verifies the outgoing `chat.send`, renders a final assistant reply, and writes screenshot/video/metadata artifacts.
- Adds a trusted evidence manifest/report builder plus focused tests.
- Adds `web-ui-chat-proof` to the generic `Mantis Scenario` dispatcher and documents the lane scope in `docs/concepts/mantis.md`.
- Wires the new Mantis workflow into changed-file owner test routing and the package-acceptance artifact-upload contract regression test.

## Evidence

Validation run locally on Windows:

- `node scripts\run-vitest.mjs run --config test\vitest\vitest.tooling.config.ts test\scripts\mantis-web-ui-chat-evidence.test.ts` - passed, 1 file / 3 tests.
- `node scripts\run-vitest.mjs run --config test\vitest\vitest.tooling.config.ts test\scripts\test-projects.test.ts` - passed, 1 file / 182 tests.
- `node scripts\run-vitest.mjs run --config test\vitest\vitest.tooling.config.ts test\scripts\package-acceptance-workflow.test.ts -t "requires live proof evidence artifacts when proof jobs run"` - passed, 1 selected test / 39 skipped.
- `node scripts\run-vitest.mjs run --config test\vitest\vitest.tooling.config.ts test\scripts\test-projects.test.ts -t "keeps Mantis proof workflow edits on workflow evidence regression tests"` - passed, 1 selected test / 181 skipped.
- `node scripts\ensure-playwright-chromium.mjs` - passed.
- `node scripts\run-vitest.mjs run --config test\vitest\vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui\src\e2e\mantis-chat-proof.e2e.test.ts` - passed, 1 file / 1 test.
- Candidate-toolchain proof invocation (`node scripts\ensure-playwright-chromium.mjs`; `node scripts\run-vitest.mjs run --config test\vitest\vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui\src\e2e\mantis-chat-proof.e2e.test.ts` with `OPENCLAW_MANTIS_WEB_UI_CHAT_OUTPUT_DIR`) - passed, 1 file / 1 test.
- Stale-candidate simulation from an `origin/main` worktree with trusted harness files copied in - passed, 1 file / 1 test.
- `node scripts\mantis\build-web-ui-chat-evidence.mjs --output-dir .artifacts\qa-e2e\mantis\web-ui-chat-proof --candidate-ref HEAD --candidate-sha <sha> --status pass` - passed and generated `mantis-evidence.json` / `mantis-report.md`.
- Local proof artifacts were generated under `.artifacts/qa-e2e/mantis/web-ui-chat-proof*`, including `web-ui-chat.png`, `web-ui-chat.webm`, `web-ui-chat-proof.json`, `mantis-report.md`, `mantis-evidence.json`, and `vitest.log`.
- `pnpm check:workflows` - passed (`actionlint`, `zizmor`, and workflow guards).
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check .github\workflows\mantis-web-ui-chat-proof.yml .github\workflows\mantis-scenario.yml docs\concepts\mantis.md scripts\mantis\build-web-ui-chat-evidence.mjs scripts\test-projects.test-support.mjs test\scripts\mantis-web-ui-chat-evidence.test.ts test\scripts\package-acceptance-workflow.test.ts test\scripts\test-projects.test.ts ui\src\e2e\mantis-chat-proof.e2e.test.ts` - passed.
- `git diff --check` - passed.
- Targeted docs proof passed: `pnpm docs:list`, `pnpm dlx --config.resolution-mode=highest markdownlint-cli2 --config config/markdownlint-cli2.jsonc --no-globs "docs/concepts/mantis.md"`, `node scripts\check-docs-mdx.mjs docs\concepts\mantis.md`, `node scripts\check-docs-i18n-glossary.mjs`, `node scripts\docs-link-audit.mjs`, and `node scripts\generate-docs-map.mjs --check`.

`pnpm check:docs` was not usable as a broad Windows closeout here: the all-docs formatter path hit the Windows command-line length limit before content checks, and a global markdownlint run also surfaces an unrelated baseline `docs/CLAUDE.md` trailing-newline issue. The changed docs page passed the targeted docs checks above.

`node scripts\run-vitest.mjs run --config test\vitest\vitest.tooling.config.ts test\scripts\package-acceptance-workflow.test.ts test\scripts\test-projects.test.ts` ran the changed owner tests together; `test-projects.test.ts` passed and the package-acceptance file hit an unrelated Windows executable-bit baseline assertion for `scripts/openclaw-release-clawhub-plan.ts`. The selected Mantis artifact-contract case above passed.

Codex review closeout:

- `codex review -c service_tier='"fast"' --base origin/main` initially found accepted workflow issues. Fixed by putting secret-bearing evidence publishing behind `environment: qa-live-shared`, copying the trusted harness into candidate worktrees, and running browser install/Vitest from the candidate checkout.
- Final full branch review before opening the PR: `codex review -c service_tier='"fast"' --base origin/main` reported no discrete, actionable regressions.
- After ClawSweeper flagged missing workflow regression coverage, `codex review -c service_tier='"fast"' --uncommitted` reported that the local changes only add workflow test routing and artifact evidence coverage and align with existing patterns.

ClawSweeper review handling:

- Initial review found `[P3] Wire the new workflow into Mantis regression coverage` plus a proof blocker for a real trusted workflow dispatch/publish artifact.
- The P3 coverage finding was fixed by adding the workflow to owner test routing and the Mantis artifact-upload regression case.
- Latest review found `[P2] Parse only explicit candidate overrides`: natural prose such as `this PR head produces...` could be parsed as `candidate_ref=produces`.

- `node scripts\run-vitest.mjs run --config test\vitest\vitest.tooling.config.ts test\scripts\test-projects.test.ts -t "keeps Mantis proof workflow edits on workflow evidence regression tests"` - passed, 1 selected test / 181 skipped.
- `node scripts\run-vitest.mjs run --config test\vitest\vitest.tooling.config.ts test\scripts\package-acceptance-workflow.test.ts -t "requires live proof evidence artifacts when proof jobs run"` - passed, 1 selected test / 39 skipped.
- `pnpm check:workflows` - passed locally on Windows.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check .github\workflows\mantis-web-ui-chat-proof.yml scripts\test-projects.test-support.mjs test\scripts\mantis-web-ui-chat-proof-workflow.test.ts test\scripts\test-projects.test.ts` - passed.
- `git diff --check` - passed.
- After the parser fix, `codex review -c service_tier='"fast"' --base origin/main` completed without discrete actionable findings; the focused workflow-parser Vitest run passed in the same review loop.

### Maintainer-Owned Actions / Mantis Proof

- PR head: `bd1f68ce0ddc11599afd85efd65f83d5c6229066`.
- Crabbox local-container proof artifacts are attached under `Crabbox Local-Container Proof Artifacts`, including the inline screenshot, browser recording, evidence report, manifest, metadata, Vitest log, and SHA256 hashes.
- Live repo permission reports `MAINTAIN` for this account.
- Direct dispatch of the new workflow file by name is still blocked until it is default-registered. The default-registered `Mantis Scenario` dispatcher run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28804070338 failed in `Dispatch selected Mantis workflow` with `HTTP 404: workflow mantis-web-ui-chat-proof.yml not found on the default branch`. This is GitHub's workflow-registration boundary, not a candidate-runtime failure.
- To exercise the remaining trusted boundaries before merge, the exact PR head was pushed to maintainer-owned branch `proof/pr100472-mantis-web-ui-chat` and opened as temporary draft proof carrier https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100991. That made `bd1f68ce0ddc11599afd85efd65f83d5c6229066` an open same-repo PR head for the candidate trust rule during the proof run; #100991 is now closed and the branch is left intact for audit traceability.
- Default-registered proof-shim run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28804452130 passed end to end against candidate `bd1f68ce0ddc11599afd85efd65f83d5c6229066`. The original dispatcher job was intentionally skipped only for `web-ui-chat-proof`; the shim then ran the same candidate validation, browser proof, artifact upload, and Mantis publish steps inline through the existing `Mantis Scenario` workflow.
- `Validate web UI chat candidate` passed and resolved the candidate as a trusted same-repo/open-PR head.
- `Run Control UI web chat proof` passed on the hosted Blacksmith runner: it prepared a detached candidate worktree at `bd1f68ce0ddc11599afd85efd65f83d5c6229066`, ran `ui/src/e2e/mantis-chat-proof.e2e.test.ts`, and reported `1 passed`.
- `Upload Mantis web UI chat artifacts` uploaded 7 files as artifact `mantis-web-ui-chat-proof-28804452130-1`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28804452130/artifacts/8114386303. Artifact ID `8114386303`, size `491679` bytes, digest `sha256:225dc1dfd664f37775041f9f10d022d7731515acd08fd4bf00aeae89d9d9b889`.
- `Publish Mantis web UI chat evidence` ran the secret-backed publish path, created a Mantis GitHub App token with issues/pull-requests write permissions, downloaded the uploaded artifact with digest verification, used the configured R2 artifact environment, and created PR evidence comment https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100472#issuecomment-4894858345.
- Public Mantis evidence artifacts from the publish job: [screenshot](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/mantis/web-ui-chat-proof/pr-100472/run-28804452130-1/web-ui-chat.png), [browser recording](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/mantis/web-ui-chat-proof/pr-100472/run-28804452130-1/web-ui-chat.webm), and [raw QA index](https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/mantis/web-ui-chat-proof/pr-100472/run-28804452130-1/index.json).
- This hosted proof covers ClawSweeper's requested candidate validation, GitHub artifact upload, and `qa-live-shared`/Mantis App/R2 publishing boundary from a maintainer-owned/default-registered Actions path. The only remaining limitation is literal dispatch of `.github/workflows/mantis-web-ui-chat-proof.yml` by filename before the workflow exists on default; GitHub rejects that pre-registration.

### Crabbox Local-Container Proof Artifacts

Crabbox proof artifacts are attached on a dedicated fork artifact branch: https://github.com/brokemac79/openclaw/tree/pr100472-docker-proof-artifacts/proof/pr100472/mantis-web-ui-chat

![Mantis web UI chat Crabbox proof screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/openclaw/pr100472-docker-proof-artifacts/proof/pr100472/mantis-web-ui-chat/web-ui-chat.png)

- Screenshot: [web-ui-chat.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/openclaw/pr100472-docker-proof-artifacts/proof/pr100472/mantis-web-ui-chat/web-ui-chat.png)
- Browser recording: [web-ui-chat.webm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/openclaw/pr100472-docker-proof-artifacts/proof/pr100472/mantis-web-ui-chat/web-ui-chat.webm)
- Evidence report: [mantis-report.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/openclaw/pr100472-docker-proof-artifacts/proof/pr100472/mantis-web-ui-chat/mantis-report.md)
- Evidence manifest: [mantis-evidence.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/openclaw/pr100472-docker-proof-artifacts/proof/pr100472/mantis-web-ui-chat/mantis-evidence.json)
- Proof metadata: [web-ui-chat-proof.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/openclaw/pr100472-docker-proof-artifacts/proof/pr100472/mantis-web-ui-chat/web-ui-chat-proof.json)
- Vitest log: [vitest.log](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/openclaw/pr100472-docker-proof-artifacts/proof/pr100472/mantis-web-ui-chat/vitest.log)
- Artifact hashes: [hashes.sha256](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/openclaw/pr100472-docker-proof-artifacts/proof/pr100472/mantis-web-ui-chat/hashes.sha256)

Crabbox proof command/result:

- Provider: `local-container`; lease: `cbx_61ddf3724d56`; image: `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.60.0-noble`; Docker Engine: `29.5.2`.
- Synced current PR branch workspace for head `bd1f68ce0ddc11599afd85efd65f83d5c6229066` into the disposable Linux container.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.tooling.config.ts test/scripts/mantis-web-ui-chat-proof-workflow.test.ts` - passed, 1 file / 1 test.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.tooling.config.ts test/scripts/package-acceptance-workflow.test.ts -t "requires live proof evidence artifacts when proof jobs run"` - passed, 1 selected test / 39 skipped.
- `node scripts/ensure-playwright-chromium.mjs` - passed.
- `OPENCLAW_MANTIS_WEB_UI_CHAT_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/mantis-web-ui-chat-proof node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/e2e/mantis-chat-proof.e2e.test.ts` - passed, 1 file / 1 test.
- `node scripts/mantis/build-web-ui-chat-evidence.mjs --output-dir /tmp/mantis-web-ui-chat-proof --candidate-ref codex/mantis-web-ui-proof --candidate-sha bd1f68ce0ddc11599afd85efd65f83d5c6229066 --status pass` - passed and generated `mantis-report.md`, `mantis-evidence.json`, `web-ui-chat-proof.json`, `vitest.log`, `web-ui-chat.png`, and `web-ui-chat.webm`.
- Generated artifact hashes: `web-ui-chat.png` SHA256 `d73557f1cc779394fdbc3ed049dd7231fd2b19176f4b5bce6f0315577d41d2ce`; `web-ui-chat.webm` SHA256 `c5977078de184f89b5f30d2fde888af3d78f5c4e65275a5ee88010e2652a164a`.

This Crabbox proof covers the parser regression, candidate browser proof, artifact-contract regression, and evidence-builder path in Linux for the current head. Crabbox alone could not prove the trusted Actions artifact upload or Mantis App/R2 publish boundary; the hosted maintainer-owned/default-registered proof-shim run above covers those later boundaries.

## Risks / Rollout

This touches `.github/workflows/**`, so it has normal GitHub workflow/OAuth-scope risk. The PR is intentionally narrow, but maintainers may need to verify branch editability or use a maintainer-owned replacement if fork workflow restrictions get in the way.

The workflow uses Mantis GitHub App and R2 publishing secrets only in the publish job, after the candidate proof job has produced artifacts. The candidate proof job runs without those publishing secrets.

Direct dispatch of `.github/workflows/mantis-web-ui-chat-proof.yml` by filename still requires the workflow to exist on default first. The hosted proof-shim run above exercises the candidate proof, Actions artifact upload, and Mantis App/R2 publish boundary through the already default-registered `Mantis Scenario` workflow before merge.

## Links

- ClawSweeper policy PR: https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/424
- ClawSweeper review on this PR: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100472#issuecomment-4887689557

The workflow uses Mantis GitHub App and R2 publishing secrets only in the publish job, after the candidate proof job has produced artifacts. The candidate proof job runs without those publishing secrets.
